description:
This PHP file defines an abstract class 'CallExpression' within the Twig templating engine, specifically in the namespace 'Twig
odeeference ar.' It contains methods for compiling callables and arguments in Twig templates, reflecting internal structures for rendering and expression evaluation.

classes.name: CallExpression
classes.description: An abstract class representing call expressions in Twig's internal syntax tree, providing methods for compiling callables and handling arguments.

methods.name: compileCallable
methods.description: Prepares the callable part of a Twig expression for compilation, handling different callable types and reflection.

methods.name: compileArguments
methods.description: Compiles the arguments for a callable in Twig, including context, environment, charset, and user-provided arguments.

methods.name: getArguments
methods.description: Deprecated method to extract and normalize arguments for callables; recommends using 'CallableArgumentsExtractor::getArguments()'.

methods.name: normalizeName
methods.description: Deprecated method to normalize argument names, converting them to lowercase and snake_case format.

methods.name: getCallableParameters
methods.description: Retrieves and inspects the parameters of a callable, including handling variadic parameters, for argument matching.

methods.name: reflectCallable
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a ReflectionCallable object for inspecting callable signatures.

methods.name: getTwigCallable
methods.description: Overrides the Twig callable based on node attributes, supporting dynamic callables for different expression types.
